headline: Callahan's Passage Wholly Warden Again as Map Lines Shift
war_summary: The lines have shifted since the afternoon edition. Callahan's Passage, where Colonials held two posts at three o'clock, now stands wholly Warden across ten squares; the day's ledger there shows seventy-nine events, forty-four of them at The Latch, the latest logged before six. Viper Pit holds Warden at eight. Map-wide, the Colonial tally has slipped from 314 to 307 strongpoints while the Warden count has risen from 121 to 128, with one square in Stonecradle lying waste. Wardens have also regained a post in the Weathered Expanse, now seven Colonial to two Warden, where the twenty-four-hour casualty rolls are the heaviest anywhere, some 12,600 Colonial and 18,200 Warden. Nevish Line reads seven Warden to one Colonial; Stlican Shelf six Colonial to three Warden, a former waste post now garrisoned; and Mooring County stands wholly Warden at twelve squares. Linn Mercy remains ten Colonial to one Warden, with events filed at this hour, while Stonecradle, seven Colonial, one Warden and one waste, has logged seven events inside two hours. Fisherman's Row stands nine Colonial to none, and hard fighting continues at Callahan's Passage, the Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf and Nevish Line.
